RECONCILIATION_AGAINST_THE_PLUS_ONE_NET.THE_FINDING: the +1 net robot on-time is NOT produced by the deferral mechanism. Both gaining questions (robo006 opp0003111 and opp0009518) were NEVER DEFERRED. The only deferred question whose on-time status changed went the wrong way. Scored on the deferred set alone the mechanism is 0 rescues against 1 loss, i.e. -1 robot on-time; the headline +1 is +2 from two undeferred robo006 questions minus that -1. 'Robot on-time did not fall overall' is true and is not evidence that the deferrals helped it.

THE_STRATUM_BESIDE_THE_MEAN._why: CLAUDE.md consistency check 3: where an effect is expected to be concentrated, report the stratum and the mixing weight beside the mean. The deferrals exist to buy alert attainment, so the alert instants inside the deferral windows are the stratum where the effect must appear.
THE_STRATUM_BESIDE_THE_MEAN.stratum_definition: alert instants whose t_opportunity falls inside one of the 22 [t, t + deferral_s] windows
THE_STRATUM_BESIDE_THE_MEAN.THE_FINDING: the effect is concentrated, and it is concentrated the WRONG WAY. Inside the deferral windows rung 4's alert on-time is 11.9 pp BELOW rung 3's on the same 227 instants (33.9 percent against 45.8), against -0.9 pp outside them. The population mean (-1.0 pp) understates what happens where the mechanism acts.
THE_STRATUM_BESIDE_THE_MEAN.LIMITATION_THE_STRATUM_IS_NOT_RANDOMISED: the windows are defined by rung 4's OWN deferral decisions, and the gate only fires when an alert episode is active with alerts pending (the 19 `no_active_alert_episode` rows are the BASE branch), so the stratum is selected on alert congestion. The cross-arm comparison is still on the SAME instants with an identical key universe, so the -11.9 pp is a real difference on those instants; what the selection forbids is reading it as the causal effect of deferring, since rung 3 has no deferrals and therefore no comparable window set of its own. Stated as a limitation, not used as a headline causal claim.

RESULTS_CONSISTENCY_CHECK.2_physical_plausibility: no rate is asserted by this run; it reports counts, flags and latency differences already committed in the cells. The deferred questions' delivery latencies rise from a 0.36-2.05 s band in rung 3 to a 1.37-3.17 s band in rung 4, consistent with a 0.22-2.18 s deferral plus the 0.1 s epoch debit, so no latency is faster than its rung-3 counterpart plus the slack spent and nothing implies a rate above the committed cost curves.
RESULTS_CONSISTENCY_CHECK.3_distribution_sanity: per-episode attainment is reported as a full distribution, not a mean: 20 distinct values over 712 episodes in each arm with the complete on-time-count histogram, min 0.0, max 1.0, IQR 0.539 (rung 4) and 0.579 (rung 3). No constant where a distribution is expected. The two mode spikes (115 and 120 episodes at a full 19 of 19, 48 episodes at 0 in both arms) are present in both arms and in the base, so they are a property of the trace, not of an arm. The concentrated-effect cousin is handled: see THE_STRATUM_BESIDE_THE_MEAN, which found a -11.9 pp effect on a 1.9 percent stratum that the -1.0 pp population mean understates. The artefact-spread cousin is handled: see CORRECTNESS_IS_AGAINST_REAL_GOLD_NOT_A_PLACEHOLDER.
RESULTS_CONSISTENCY_CHECK.4_definition_audit: attainment, on-time, episode, alert and the per-episode denominator are all taken from d179_rung2_verdict.py and are quoted in DEFINITION_USED. One name was found carrying two values, and it is the bar itself: 'rung 3's attainment at s4' is 0.441233 in the frozen pre-registration (covex-v6-fair-c5attr) and 0.619234 for the named comparator (covex-v6-fair-final). Both are the SAME definition on DIFFERENT cells, reported and flagged rather than reconciled by choice. query type is by device-id prefix, and the (prefix, kind, deadline_s) cross-tab matched the expected set on all three cells.
RESULTS_CONSISTENCY_CHECK.5_claim_linkage: bears on the rung-4 pre-registration in reports/study_rung4_counterfactual.md section 4, conjunct 1 (alert attainment) and conjunct 2 (robot on-time retention), and on D191's named column 'any recall made late by a deferral', which this run answers with a census: exactly one, robo006 opp0003132. Nothing measured here is scoped out by FORMULATION.md.
RESULTS_CONSISTENCY_CHECK.6_proxy_validity: no proxy is used for the headline. Two registers are kept apart rather than substituted: the committed offline `_within` rule is PRIMARY throughout and the coordinator's online cloud_payload.on_time first-token flag is reported only beside it (the two give the same FAIL verdict on bar 1). The deferral-window stratum is flagged as selected-on-congestion and not used as a causal claim. The cell's metrics_health is `never_scraped`, so engine-reported metric quantities are untrusted; NOTHING in this verdict reads an engine metric. Every number here comes from outcomes.jsonl.gz, request.jsonl.gz, decision.jsonl.gz, rd_decisions.jsonl.gz or the cell's own committed score block.
RESULTS_CONSISTENCY_CHECK.7_validate_the_control: the committed scorer's own positive control was run FIRST, on all three cells, and passed 3 of 3: it re-derived robot_pool_on_time, robot_pool_n, ss_pool_on_time, ss_pool_n, dashcam_on_time and dashcam_n_instants from the raw logs and matched each cell's committed score.score.sweep[0] block EXACTLY, 18 of 18 counts, 0 tolerance. The base and the rung-3 comparator were audited the same way as the arm under test, so neither side of the comparison is unexamined: rung 3's own attainment 0.619234 and the base's 0.44249 both reproduce their committed values exactly. Had the control failed, the scorer would have been the broken thing and no comparison would have been read.
